correctness.rationale: The helper implements the inspectable exit/result contract end-to-end: PR-number validation, allow-list load with [bot] stripping, INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT defaults, pre- and post-snapshot head SHA checks, and RESULT=/HEAD= emissions for CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, and API_ERROR with documented exit codes 0/0/3/2/4. Bats stubs exercise all five branches. Three-point deduction: CONVERGED fires when SNAP_UNRESOLVED_BOT_THREADS equals zero without verifying that participating allow-listed bots are terminal for the current head (the GraphQL query fetches only reviewThreads, not submitted PR reviews), so a PR with no bot threads yet can return CONVERGED immediately—contrary to the task's dual-condition CONVERGED definition. Additional minor gaps: reviewThreads(first:100) and comments(first:1) are unpaginated, and isOutdated is fetched but never applied in analyze_snapshot.

quality.rationale: Implementation is clear, maintainable, and repo-consistent: structured shell helpers (emit_result, gh_head_sha/gh_graphql test seams, normalize_login, analyze_snapshot), stderr diagnostics, in-memory-only state, and a well-documented header with deliberate pre-#321 scope limits. Docs are thoroughly synced—pr-resolve-all.md adds a settle-window section preferring the helper while preserving the 6-minute fallback; AI_REPO_GUIDE.md, scripts/README.md, scripts/lib/README.md, and scripts/tests/README.md all index the new surfaces; op-issue-workflow.md references the helper. Check wiring via scripts/checks/160-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh follows existing pass/fail plus run_bats_check patterns. One-point deduction for unpaginated GraphQL (first:100 threads, first comment only) and unused isOutdated field in snapshot analysis.

No AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, or unrelated state-surface churn appears in files-changed.txt; objective process scored 15/15.
